title: Mathematics
subtitle: Textbook for Class VI
_volume: part is 1 because the Class 6 chapters declare the subject Mathematics I, and volumeName composes title + part, so this cover is found as that volume's jacket and its title page. Class 6 has one mathematics volume, so neither the front nor the spine prints a part.
_direction: patchwork, this volume's own. The front is a contents page drawn as ten tiles, one per chapter, each showing what the chapter does: triangular numbers (Looking for Patterns), an angle (Lines and Angles), 6174 (Number Play), a bar chart (Data Handling), a factor tree (Prime Time), squares counted for area (Perimeter and Area), three quarters (Fractions), two compass circles (Playing with Constructions), a mirror-symmetric shape (Symmetry) and a number line through zero (The Other Side of Zero). Brick red with sky blue and peach, and the face Outfit: none of these is on another wrap, and nothing is taken from arc or from Class 7. The back is Class 6's own panel with a plain straight edge. The edition is class6, so the wrap is two 196 x 276 trims and a spine. No finish is declared: on a direction the finish is inert.
_spine: pages is measured from a --book run of class-6 Mathematics I, rounded up to a multiple of four. Get a printer's quote and set spineWidth before press.
